Nivel de vechime: Începător

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
We are HCLTech, one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world and home to 225,000+ people across 60 countries, supercharging progress through industry-leading capabilities centered around Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind that work, our people, are diverse, creative, and passionate, raising the bar for excellence on a regular basis. We, in turn, work hard to bring out the best in them as we strive to help them find their spark and become the best version of themselves that they can be.
 If all this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, then you’re in the right place. Join us on our journey in advancing the technological world through innovation and creativity.
 We are looking for Junior C++ / PyTorch AI Framework Engineers to support development, debugging and validation of software for AI/deep-learning frameworks and hardware accelerators.
 The role involves C++ and Python development, software analysis, bug fixing, implementation of tests and validation of AI framework components.
 Your Role & Responsibilities 
 Responsibilities 
Develop and maintain software components using C++ and Python.
Support implementation of features for PyTorch and AI framework components.
Analyze existing code and investigate software defects.
Implement bug fixes and code changes.
Develop unit and automated tests.
Execute software validation and analyze test results.
Prepare code patches and code snippets.
Document defects and dependencies on other software components.
Follow established coding, testing and code-review guidelines.
Collaborate with distributed engineering teams.
 Qualifications & Experience 
 Mandatory Skills 
Good knowledge of C++ .
Working knowledge of Python .
Basic/working knowledge of Linux.
Software development fundamentals.
Basic understanding of machine learning/deep learning.
Familiarity with PyTorch or another deep-learning framework.
Basic understanding of software testing and debugging.
Git or another source-control system.
Good problem-solving capability.
Good written and spoken English.
 Preferred Skills 
PyTorch development/project experience.
NumPy / pytest.
GPU or accelerator exposure.
CUDA, SYCL, oneAPI, OpenCL or similar technologies.
HPC or numerical-computing exposure.
CMake / GDB.
Understanding of tensors and deep-learning operators.
Open-source contribution experience.
 What do we offer? 
1066 RON monthly budget in Benefit Online Platform
25 vacation days/year.
Life Insurance cover.
The employees working on bank holidays will benefit either a paid day off in the next 30 days + 100% of the hourly base salary for that specific day OR 200% of the hourly base salary for that specific day.
Childbirth allowance of 7000 RON after 1 year in HCLTech.
In the first 8 weeks, the company will pay the difference of up to 100% for the parental leave granted to pregnant employees.
Unfortunate events allowance of 7000 RON for first degree relative granted from day 1 in HCLTech.
Internal trainings and certifications.
